I have farmed this land since I was young, and I know what works here. I do not have cash to buy chemical fertilizer from the agro-dealer, and I am afraid to borrow money, so I will not use it; I will spread compost from behind my house and some ash on the mounds instead. I will plant the cassava stems I kept from my last harvest because buying new seeds is costly and I don't trust what I haven't seen grow. My children and I will do all the work with our own hands because paying laborers is money I do not have, and God will send the rains as He always does.
